description: Administrator-level Windows shell replacement with a native taskbar, file manager, search, and system utilities.
pre_uninstall: throw "WinRust rollback failed with exit code $exitCode. Scoop will keep WinRust installed until the cleanup errors are resolved."
notes: Nonportable: WinRust.exe declares requireAdministrator. Launching it can install selected components under Program Files and change the Windows shell, services, registry, and Start Menu integration; the launcher itself remains in the Scoop app directory.

Scoop uninstall runs WinRust.exe rollback --yes with UAC elevation and stops removal if rollback fails. The hook is restricted to the uninstall command, so Scoop upgrades do not roll back the installed WinRust components.
The upstream purge feature permanently removes selected built-in Windows apps. Those removals cannot be restored by WinRust rollback or by uninstalling this Scoop manifest.
The upstream executable is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may display a warning.
